world.title: Ethiopia, Russia Vow to Deepen Longstanding Ties Across Key Sectors
world.description:
Addis Ababa, October 29, 2026 (ENA)— Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has held talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin to advance Ethiopia–Russia relations, with discussions focusing on expanding cooperation in nuclear energy, health, trade, and other areas of mutual interest.
Describing the bilateral meeting as fruitful, Prime Minister Abiy said the discussions explored avenues for further strengthening the longstanding partnership between the two countries, including cooperation on bilateral and multilateral issues.
 
The talks underscored the two countries’ continued engagement in broadening collaboration across strategic sectors and advancing their shared interests.
In a gesture highlighting the importance of dialogue and mutual understanding, Prime Minister Abiy also presented President Putin with the Russian edition of his book, Medemer.
“I also personally presented President Putin with the Russian edition of my book, Medemer, reflecting our shared commitment to dialogue, mutual understanding, and the continued advancement of Ethiopia–Russia relations.”
 
Rooted in the concept of synergy and cooperation, Medemer adds an intellectual dimension to Ethiopia’s engagement with Russia, reflecting the potential of dialogue and shared ideas to foster mutual understanding and further strengthen bilateral relations.
